test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I am sure that / the postman would be / coming shortly / to deliver the letter.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"the postman would be."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"the postman would be."**
 
• The phrase **"will be"** is used in the blank to express a future action with a sense of certainty.
 
• In the context of the sentence, the speaker is confident or certain that the postman is going to come shortly to deliver the letter.
 
• The use of **"will be" **conveys a future event that is expected or anticipated, and the adverb "shortly" further emphasizes the immediacy of the action.
 
• So, we need to replace** "would" **with **"will."**
 
• ​So, the correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *I am sure that the **postman will be**__ coming shortly to deliver the letter.*
